==================================================

==================================================

Run:

Also inspect:

and identify the exact files belonging to:

- pre-existing Stage F–G work
- Stage H/I work

- Stage K work

==================================================
2. PROTECT ALL LEGITIMATE WORK
==================================================

Do NOT reset.
Do NOT restore.
Do NOT discard.
Do NOT delete untracked files.

There is legitimate uncommitted work from previous stages.

Confirm that all legitimate Stage F–K work is present.

==================================================
3. SECRET CHECK
==================================================

Before staging anything, inspect for credentials/secrets.

Confirm:

- .env remains ignored
- no API keys/passwords/tokens/secrets are being staged
- .env.example contains placeholders only
- no credentials appear in git diff

If a secret is found, STOP.

Do not commit it.

==================================================
4. STAGE THE COMPLETED WORK
==================================================

Stage the legitimate completed project work that is currently uncommitted.

Do NOT stage:

- .env
- credentials
- temporary files
- debug files
- scratch files
- unrelated personal files
- .kilo/ unless it is intentionally tracked project configuration

After staging, run:

git status
git diff --cached --stat
git diff --cached --check

Inspect the staged diff.

==================================================
5. FINAL TEST VERIFICATION
==================================================

Before committing, run the full test suite again.

Expected:

454/454

Also run:

git diff --cached --check

Do not commit if tests fail.

==================================================
6. COMMIT
==================================================

If everything is clean, create ONE checkpoint commit containing the completed work.

Use a clear commit message such as:

Do NOT amend an older commit.

Do NOT rewrite history.

==================================================
7. VERIFY COMMIT
==================================================

Run:

git status
git log --oneline -3
git show --stat --oneline HEAD

Confirm the working tree is clean except for anything explicitly identified as intentionally untracked/uncommitted.

==================================================
8. PUSH
==================================================

The repository is already configured with origin and the branch is main.

Push the new checkpoint:

Do not force push.
